BMW Team Listerine: Vic Lee Racing runs two BMW M3s with Listerine backing. Will Hoy and Ray Bellm drive.
Vauxhall Sport: Dave Cook Racing runs the works Vauxhall Cavaliers. The car already raced in 1990.
Kaliber ICS Team Toyota: Andy Rouse Engineering runs two Toyota Carinas for Toyota.
BMW Team Finance: Prodrive runs the factory BMW M3s. Steve Soper shares car 44 when he is free from the DTM.
BMW Team Labatt's: The second Vic Lee Racing pair of BMW M3s, with Labatt's backing.
Graham Goode Racing: A privateer Ford Sierra RS Cosworth, restricted to Super Touring speed.
Trakstar Motorsport: Robb Gravett's own team. It is the only Ford entry with manufacturer status.
Nissan Janspeed Racing: Janspeed runs the new Nissan Primera from round 2. A second car joins late in the year.
John Maguire Racing: Mitsubishi's single car. It starts the year as a Lancer and becomes a Galant.
